setting: A present-day 55+ golf cart community in central Florida. Tone: warm, comic, realistic.

laws.title: Cart Modifications
laws.text: Exterior golf cart modifications visible from the street require Architectural Review approval.

laws.title: Lawn Ornaments
laws.text: No more than 3 decorative ornaments may be visible from the street.

laws.title: Quiet Hours
laws.text: No amplified sound from 10 PM to 7 AM.

laws.title: Holiday Decor
laws.text: Holiday lighting is permitted from Thanksgiving through January 15.

laws.title: Court Reservations
laws.text: Pickleball courts may be reserved for a maximum of 2 hours per party.

laws.title: Parking
laws.text: No parking on the grass. Carts and cars stay on driveways or the street.

gary.name: Gary Kowalski
gary.profession: Retired HVAC engineer from Toledo; the street's unofficial fix-it guy
gary.traits: Helpful to a fault, stubborn, chatty, tinkerer, quietly lonely (widowed two years ago)
gary.current_goal: Rig his golf cart with lights and a sound system for the Holiday Golf Cart Parade

donna.name: Donna Pruitt
donna.profession: Retired real estate agent from New Jersey; social chair of three clubs
donna.core_motivations: Being at the center of the social scene
donna.current_goal: Climb the pickleball ladder by recruiting Gary as her doubles partner, even though he has never played

hal.name: Hal Weems
hal.profession: Retired Army supply sergeant; self-appointed deed-restriction watchdog
hal.traits: By-the-book, grumpy, dry wit, observant, secretly soft-hearted
hal.current_goal: Report Gary's unauthorized cart modifications and Donna's flamingo collection to the architectural review committee

rosa.name: Rosa Delgado
rosa.profession: ER nurse from Miami, recently semi-retired; still picks up per-diem shifts
rosa.core_motivations: Building a real community after an uprooting move
rosa.current_goal: Host a welcome dinner and get all three neighbors at the same table
